title: Transitions
summary: Hard, on-beat transitions in the editorial opener style, shown going from the sample clip (under the editorial grade) to a title card: seven of its own, where the frame itself rearranges on the charcoal canvas (strips that slide in or fall away, a 2x2 mosaic whose cells change one by one, a card that punches up, a slot that widens, letterbox bars that close on the beat, a white flash cut), and four from the shared set drawn with charcoal gutters instead of glowing rims.
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "strip_wipe", "seconds": 0.6}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "card_punch", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.6}]. Keep them short (0.4-0.8 s) and on the beat. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: strip wipe
items.description: The next shot arrives in three vertical strips sliding in from alternate ends in a scattered order, landing hard, with charcoal gutters until the last lands. The theme default.

items.name: strip drop
items.description: The shot falls away in three vertical strips to alternate ends, accelerating; the next shot comes up from the charcoal underneath.

items.name: mosaic flip
items.description: The frame opens into a 2x2 mosaic with charcoal gutters; the cells change to the next shot one at a time, each pushed in from the side, and the gutters close.

items.name: card punch
items.description: The shot steps back into a centred card on charcoal, cuts to the next shot on the beat, and the card punches up to full frame with a small overshoot.

items.name: slot open
items.description: Charcoal closes in from the sides to a narrow slot, the slot cuts to the next shot and widens back to full frame.

items.name: letterbox snap
items.description: Letterbox bars close from top and bottom in three beats to a thin band with hairline rules, cut, and open again in three beats on the next shot.

items.name: flash cut
items.description: The shot pushes in and blows out to white; the next hits slightly zoomed in black and white and settles to itself and its colour.

items.name: tile flip
items.description: Shared: a grid of cards turns over in a diagonal wave with the next shot on their backs, here two across with charcoal gutters.

items.name: accordion fold
items.description: Shared: the shot folds up like a concertina of three vertical panels toward the left edge, uncovering the next.

items.name: swing doors
items.description: Shared: the shot splits down the middle into two doors that swing open away from the camera onto the next.

items.name: zoom through
items.description: Shared: the camera flies through the shot into the next with a radial streak.
